### Load environment

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library("TCGAbiolinks")
library("tidyverse")
```

### Load data

```{r}
# Load MANIFEST
manifest_df <- read_tsv(file="../data/_raw/MANIFEST.txt",
                         show_col_types = FALSE)

# Extract dataset ids from MANIFEST
manifest_ids <- manifest_df |>
  pull(id)
```

```{r}
# Queue TGCA for data
data_query <- GDCquery(
  project = "BEATAML1.0-COHORT",
  data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
  data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
  workflow.type = "STAR - Counts"
)
```

```{r}
# Filter results based on MANIFEST
query_result <- getResults(data_query)

# Update query result based on this
data_query$results[[1]] <- query_result |> 
  filter(id %in% manifest_ids)
```

```{r}
# Verify succesfull filtering
success_flag <- nrow(data_query$results[[1]]) == length(manifest_ids)
```

```{r}
# Download filtered query data
if (success_flag) {
  GDCdownload(query = data_query,
            directory = "../data/_raw")
} else {
  cat("Mismatch in size between filtered query and MANIFEST ids provided.")
}
```
